verdicts.note: Tested toward -1 and it does not hold. He has been at the office since 1997, rising from D.A.R.E. instructor to undersheriff [S1][S2], and has been sheriff since 2015 or 2016 with a 2022 re-election [S2][S3]. He runs on that record: jail upgrades, equipment, training [S3]. That is the maximal proven-record profile. The basis says '28-year career'; 1997 to 2026 is about 29 years, which is not material.

His stated priorities are recruiting and retaining staff, training and equipment for deputies, corrections officers and dispatchers, and jail funding [S1][S3]. That is the staffing side of pole_a. The youth-outreach and community-trust programs [S1] keep it at -1, not -2, and there is no diversion or treatment agenda. Medium fits a single pamphlet statement backed by the CBH announcement. His immigration-cooperation stance [S2] is correctly kept out, since immigration is not scored for county offices.

He has never held elected office [S1] and challenges the sitting sheriff for the second time [S3]. He is still a 29-year career officer [S2], so the outsider case is partial and +1 at medium is right, consistent with the Grant sheriff challenger adjustment. No safety score is right: his statement is about presence and trust, with no stated policy [S1][S2].
